_help: Calendar (systems/calendar.js) + season look (world/seasons.js). A year = the seasons in order, each daysPerSeason long; day 0 of a new game = the first day of the first season. look colours are what the world looks like at noon; each is scaled by how bright the time-of-day palette makes that colour relative to the FIRST season's look (keep the first season equal to the 'day' palette in palettes.json), so nights stay dark and sunsets warm. grassH = grass height, leafScale = size of tree leaves (thin crowns in winter), leafMix / leafMixColor = how much every leaf is recoloured towards that colour, groundLeaves = colour of the fallen leaves (null = hidden). deadGrass = share of the grass in brown dead patches (0..1), snow = snow lying on props + snow mounds (0..1, fresh snowfall adds a bit). particles = ambient particles of the season (petal | leaf | none). footprints = how dark the kid's footprints are (0 = none), printLife = seconds before one fades. env = flags for systems/stats.js conditions (survival.json: conditions[].env), envNight / envNoon only at night (20-6) / at noon (11-15.5). weather = chance of each weather per day (weathers below).

seasons.name: Musim Semi
seasons.desc: Bunga bermekaran dan kelopak sakura beterbangan. Udara segar membuat stamina lebih cepat pulih. Sering gerimis.

seasons.name: Musim Panas
seasons.desc: Rumput paling hijau dan matahari terik. Siang hari (11:00-15:30) di luar bikin Kepanasan: cepat haus. Kadang hujan badai.

seasons.name: Musim Gugur
seasons.desc: Daun menguning dan berguguran, rumput mulai kecokelatan. Udara sejuk: tidak mudah haus. Hujan cukup sering.

seasons.name: Musim Dingin
seasons.desc: Salju menutupi tanah, pohon meranggas. Di luar kamu Kedinginan (stamina cepat habis, cepat lapar), malam hari Membeku (darah turun). Tangkal dengan teh/cokelat hangat atau sup.

_weathers: badai (storm) = heavy rain that also damages crops outdoors and scatters branches on the farm (js/features/farming). dim = how much darker the sky/sun get (1 = normal). fx = weather particles (rain | snow | none), amount 0..1. env = extra stats.js flags while it lasts. prints = footprint darkness multiplier (mud / fresh snow).
